_provenance.method: One HTTP GET per product page, 3 s apart. No JavaScript execution, no API calls, no authentication, no CAPTCHA handling, no bot-protection circumvention. 5 of the 10-product guidance for a single chain.

paths_deliberately_NOT_requested: /mds/  (Disallow, line 18) - plausibly a master-data service and therefore the most likely place a GTIN would exist. Off-limits; NOT probed.
/ua-bot.html (Disallow, line 8) - despite its name, the site explicitly disallows it. NOT requested.

_provenance.extraction_path: script#__NEXT_DATA__ -> props.pageProps.apiData (a STRINGIFIED JSON string, must be json.loads'd a second time) -> entry 'PRODUCT_DETAIL_GET' -> res.products[0]

optional_keys_confirmed_by_observation.brandName: ABSENT on Bananen (own-brand fresh produce, no brand assigned)
optional_keys_confirmed_by_observation.promotionPrices: ABSENT on the 2 non-promoted products -> presence of this key is the reliable on-promotion signal
optional_keys_confirmed_by_observation.strikePrice: PRESENT if and only if on promotion (3 of 3 promo products had it; 0 of 2 non-promo did)
optional_keys_confirmed_by_observation.basePrice: ABSENT on Weizenmehl (1-kg pack) -> unit price must be computed, not read

gtin_finding.conclusion: Aldi Nord exposes NO barcode/GTIN on its product pages.
gtin_finding.method: Exhaustive: scanned all 5 pages for any 8-14 digit numeric token (none), and for the keywords gtin/ean/barcode/gtin13/articleNumber/artikelnummer/vendorCode (only 3 'ean' substring hits per page, which are false positives inside words such as 'Clean'/'Cream'/'Mean', not a field). Listed all 24 product-object keys - none is a barcode.
gtin_finding.residual_uncertainty: A GTIN may exist behind /mds/, which robots.txt disallows. NOT probed. This is therefore 'not available from the permitted pages', not 'provably absent from the site'.
